subject: Follow-up: Post-call recap + economic buyer & procurement steps — Summit Retail
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@summitretail.com>, Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@summitretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Post-call recap + economic buyer & procurement steps — Summit Retail

Hi Lisa and Carlos —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- TL;DR: Redwood can reduce inference cost and improve latency for your recommender pipeline by serving the model at dedicated capacity with prefix caching.
- Outcomes from our call: technical fit looks good for the POC; performance target ~75ms p99 for 512 tokens, target throughput 600 qps during peak.
- Ask: to scope commercials and approval path, can you confirm who the economic buyer / budget owner is for this initiative (IT/Prod infra budget or merchandising analytics)?
- Procurement: you mentioned a standard vendor onboarding + security questionnaire — we can share our security summary and SOC evidence.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll send our pricing one-pager and a short mutual action plan (attached).
2) If you confirm the budget owner, I’d love a quick intro (5–10 min) to align on contract cadence and timeline.
3) Meanwhile, Marissa will scope a dedicated capacity quote once we know the target SLA and commitment length.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_one-pager.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx, redwood_security_summary.pdf

Availability: I’m open for a 15-min sync Tue/Wed mornings PT.

Thanks,
Rishi
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@summitretail.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@summitretail.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Post-call recap + economic buyer & procurement steps — Summit Retail

Thanks Rishi — good recap and materials. A couple quick notes from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Carlos (cc’d) owns the analytics/ML infra spend for the merchandising org; finance signs off but he controls the budget.
- Procurement lead: procurement@summitretail.com — they’ll need our vendor form + the SOC2 report.
- Timeline: we’re targeting a pilot decision by end of Q2 (June) so we can run the seasonality tests in Q3.

Carlos — can you confirm you’re the right person for the budget approval? If yes, happy to intro to our procurement contact once you’re comfortable with the legal/commercial outline.

-Lisa
Director, Merchandising Analytics
Summit Retail

On Tue, Feb 17, 2026 at 09:45 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks all,
> 
> Following up on Lisa’s note — Carlos, would you be open to a 10-min intro with our Head of Customer Success and Marissa to run through a rough mutual action plan and procurement checklist? No contract or signature expected at that time; just want to align on decision owners and timeline.
> 
> Best,
> Rishi

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@summitretail.com>, Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@summitretail.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Post-call recap + economic buyer & procurement steps — Summit Retail

Thanks Lisa/Carlos — quick note from the solutions side: 

- Once we have the economic buyer confirmed (Carlos), we can draft two commercial options for the pilot: 1) 3-mo pilot on shared capacity + performance SLA; 2) 6-mo reserved capacity with a modest commit discount.
- For procurement: we can provide a redacted SOC2 report and the vendor questionnaire; I’ll loop Legal if we hit any non-standard contract items.
- I’ll prep the quick MAP and send a short one-page commercial summary by EOD Thursday.

Carlos — can you advise on preferred process for vendor intake? If procurement@summitretail.com is standard, would you want the MAP and SOC pushed to procurement or shall we coordinate via you first?

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@summitretail.com>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@summitretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Post-call recap + economic buyer & procurement steps — Summit Retail

Thanks all — great alignment. Carlos — appreciate you confirming you’re the budget owner. To keep momentum, two asks: 

1) Quick intro: could you please introduce me (Rishi) to the procurement contact (procurement@summitretail.com) and cc Marissa? A short sentence like “Intro to evaluate vendor and run security intake” is perfect.
2) Timeline: does end-of-June decision still look realistic for your team? If you want, we can propose a simple 6-week pilot plan to compress evaluation.

I’ll drop the MAP and commercial one-pager into the thread and share the SOC2 redacted PDF with procurement directly if you prefer.

Thanks again — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Rishi
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
